reuse.why: Extracts a shared isHoliday into shared/schedules.ts and uses it from both isNonWorkingDay and the daily path in app.ts, though app.ts still composes its own weekend-or-holiday check instead of exporting isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The holiday-matching rule now lives once; only the pre-existing weekend||holiday composition in getDatesInRange remains as a parallel copy of isNonWorkingDay.

placement.why: The matching rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the other schedule date helpers that both server and shared code import.

scope.why: Only the matching helper, its two call sites and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, readable helper with a single definition of what a holiday entry matches; minor nit of the out-of-order import and the remaining duplicated weekend composition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts getDatesInRange now goes through isHoliday; it still inlines d.isWeekend rather than isNonWorkingDay, but that was pre-existing.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the holiday match was centralised rather than copied.
